facts: Borders Libya, Sudan, Israel and the Gaza Strip
About 114 million people (2026), the most of any Arab country
worth_knowing: Mostly desert: about 99% of Egyptians live along the narrow Nile Valley and Delta, on about 5.5% of the land. The Sinai Peninsula puts its northeast corner in Asia.
